name: human-specialist
description: Queue, route and ring human agents over Plivo, with the agent desk in the browser. After the deploy, set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to the app's URL.

HS_SETUP_PLIVO_AUTH_ID.description: The Auth ID of the Plivo account that registers the first organization without the operator key.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Leave empty. After the deploy, copy the app's URL from Settings > Domains into this config var.

HS_OPERATOR_KEY.description: Bearer key for the operator routes.

HS_SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts Plivo tokens at rest. Keep a copy: without it they cannot be decrypted.
